text.en: What is RAG?

tr: İlgili parçaları bulup modele verip cevabı onlara dayandırmak
en: Finding relevant chunks, giving them to the model and basing the answer on them

explanation.en: Retrieval-augmented generation.

text.tr: RAG'in modelin genel bilgisine göre üstünlüğü nedir?
text.en: What is RAG's advantage over the model's general knowledge?

tr: Bilgi güncel tutulabilir, kaynak gösterilebilir ve cevap denetlenebilir
en: The information can be kept current, sources shown and the answer checked

explanation.tr: Belge değişince modeli yeniden eğitmek gerekmez.
explanation.en: When a document changes the model need not be retrained.

text.tr: Sistem mesajı RAG'de modelden ne ister?
text.en: What does the system message ask of the model in RAG?

tr: Yalnızca kaynaklardan cevap, kaynak numarası ve cevap yoksa bunu söylemek
en: Answer only from the sources, cite the number and say so if there is no answer

explanation.tr: Modelin buna her zaman uyacağı varsayılmaz; cevap denetlenir.
explanation.en: It is not assumed the model always complies; the answer is checked.

text.en: How are the sources put into the prompt?

en: Numbered, in the user message before the question
At random at the end of the system message

explanation.en: The numbers make citing possible.

text.en: What is the example reader in this section?

tr: Gerçek modelin yerine konmuş, en çok ortak kelimeli cümleyi seçen kaba bir fonksiyon
en: A crude function standing in for the real model that picks the sentence with the most shared words

explanation.tr: Amacı düzeneğin geri kalanını çalıştırıp ölçmek.
explanation.en: Its purpose is to run and measure the rest of the setup.

text.en: When does the reader say "not found"?

en: When the number of shared words is below the threshold
When a source is too long

explanation.en: Thresholds 2 and 1 were tried in the lesson.

text.en: What did the setup without sources (k=0) do?

explanation.en: The reader had no text to rest on.

text.tr: Gerçek bir model kaynaksız sorulunca ne yapardı?
text.en: What would a real model do when asked without sources?

tr: Genel bilgisinden bir cevap yazardı; mağazanın kurallarını bilemezdi
en: Write an answer from its general knowledge; it could not know the shop's rules

explanation.en: This is the door to hallucination.

text.tr: 3 kaynak ve eşik 2 ile sonuç neydi?
text.en: What was the result with 3 sources and threshold 2?

explanation.tr: Cevabı olmayan üç sorunun üçünde de "bulamadım".
explanation.en: All three questions with no answer got "not found".

text.en: What did lowering the threshold from 2 to 1 change?

en: Correct rose to 17, but wrong rose from 2 to 7

explanation.en: Missed fell from 7 to 2.

text.tr: Yanlış cevabın pahalı olduğu bir uygulamada hangi eşik seçilir?
text.en: Which threshold is chosen where a wrong answer is costly?

explanation.en: Fewer wrong answers, more "not found".

text.tr: Kaynaklar her çağrıya ortalama kaç token ekledi?
text.en: How many tokens did the sources add to each call on average?

explanation.en: The number of sources is a cost trade-off.

text.en: What is the "wrong retrieval" error?

en: The search not finding the right chunk
The reader picking the wrong sentence

explanation.en: "money back" ran into the word mismatch from 09.

text.tr: "Getirileni yanlış kullanma" hatasına bölümden bir örnek nedir?
text.en: What is an example of "misusing what was retrieved" from the section?

tr: "year" kelimesi yüzünden kuruluş yılı sorusunun uyku tulumu cümlesine bağlanması
en: The founding-year question tied to the sleeping-bag sentence because of "year"

explanation.tr: Okuyucu tek bir ortak kelimeye kandı.
explanation.en: The reader was fooled by a single shared word.

text.en: Why is the search measured first in RAG?

en: The model cannot use information in a chunk it was not given

explanation.en: The key@k measure from 09.

text.tr: Çok sayıda kaynak vermenin sakıncası nedir?
text.en: What is the drawback of giving many sources?

tr: Token ve maliyet artar; ilgisiz parçalar modeli şaşırtabilir
en: Tokens and cost rise; unrelated chunks can mislead the model

explanation.en: Too few sources can miss the information.

text.en: What is done in RAG when a document changes?

tr: Yalnızca o belgenin parçaları yeniden vektöre çevrilir
en: Only that document's chunks are turned into vectors again

explanation.en: Freshness is a strength of RAG.

text.en: How many messages does `build_messages` return?

explanation.en: The sources and the question are in the user message.

text.en: What does "abstain ok" mean in the evaluation?

en: Saying "not found" for a question with no answer
Saying "not found" for a question with an answer

explanation.en: "Not found" for a question with an answer is "missed".

text.en: When was an answer counted as "correct"?

en: When the answer phrase (key) appears in the answer
When there is a source number

explanation.en: A simple but measurable criterion.

text.en: What do this section's numbers show?

tr: Düzeneğin davranışını; bir modelin başarısını değil
en: How the setup behaves; not how good a model is

explanation.en: The reader is a crude example.

text.tr: Arama "Do gift cards expire?" için en üste hangi kaynağı koydu?
text.en: Which source did the search put first for "Do gift cards expire?"?

tr: Hediye kartlarının 3 yıl geçerli olduğunu söyleyen cümle
en: The sentence saying gift cards are valid for 3 years

explanation.en: The reader also picked it and wrote [1].

text.tr: RAG cevabını denetlemek için 08'den hangi yöntem kullanılabilir?
text.en: Which method from 08 can be used to check a RAG answer?

tr: Cevaptaki ayrıntıların kaynakta geçip geçmediğini denetlemek
en: Checking whether the details in the answer appear in the source

explanation.tr: Kaynak numarasının doğru parçayı gösterdiği de denetlenir.
explanation.en: Whether the source number points to the right chunk is checked too.

text.en: What does the next section measure?

tr: Arama ve cevap hatalarını ayrı ayrı

explanation.en: Evaluating RAG.
